purpose: Guide a live governed run back to its required workflow; do not grade model wording or require a deterministic transcript.

controls.rule: Activate the exact stage contract and satisfy its Definition of Ready before doing stage work.
Derive graph quality and complete blast radius before the one selective lens mapping.
controls.correction: Return to the canonical ReviewKernel. Repair graph quality or impact first, then consume its single persisted routing decision; do not independently remap lenses.

controls.rule: Seal one immutable diff, impact, requirement, and acceptance context before lens dispatch; collect every leased result into one canonical revision.
controls.correction: Use the persisted ReviewKernel envelope and its leased result slots. Do not let lenses re-read the repository to recreate diff or impact; collect the canonical revision before submitting pass.

controls.rule: Evaluate seals the exact diff, impact, requirement, acceptance criteria, tests, Design conformance, and provenance without any lens route, slot, disposition, retry, lease, or lens-result collection.
controls.correction: Return to the existing zero-lens evaluator output contract. Complete the evidence judgment against its sealed context; do not create or collect lens work.

controls.rule: Declare, validate, and host-observe the exact versioned output before submission.
controls.correction: Return to the existing output contract. Validate native structured output or the exact governed file and its host-observed producer/write receipt; do not admit prose or synthesize provenance.

controls.rule: Workers submit evidence and stop. Only the orchestrator evaluates and advances a gate.
Never infer, synthesize, or self-record human approval, selection, sign-off, or escalation resolution.
Definition of Done and required evidence must pass before the orchestrator advances the stage.
